paite: "Huan Sardis a saptuamte angel kiang an hichibang in gelh in: Pathian Kha sagih leh aksi sagih neipa'n hiai thilte agen hi. "Na thilhihte ka thei, si napi in hingmin na pu hi.
heading: Sardis Saptuamte Kiang A Laikhak
english: “And to the angel of the assembly in Sardis write: “He who has the seven Spirits of God, and the seven stars says these things: “I know your works, that you have a reputation of being alive, but you are dead.

paite: Kiveng in, thil omsunte, si dia kisate, tungding nawn in; ka Pathian ma ah na thilhih zohsa set theih ka mu kei hi.
english: Wake up, and keep the things that remain, which you were about to throw away, for I have found no works of yours perfected before my God.

paite: Huaiziak in na muhdan leh na zakdan theigige in; kem inla, kisik in. Huchi a na kiven keileh guta bang in ka hong pai dia, bangchik hun in ahia nang ka hong phawn ding chih na thei kei hi.
english: Remember therefore how you have received and heard. Keep it, and repent. If therefore you won’t watch, I will come as a thief, and you won’t know what hour I will come upon you.

paite: Himahleh Sardis ah min tawmchik apuante uh hihnit louh na nei hi; amaute puanngou silh a kei toh tonkhawm ding a kilawm him ahi uhi.
english: Nevertheless you have a few names in Sardis that did not defile their garments. They will walk with me in white, for they are worthy.

paite: Avualzoupa huchibang in puanngou in akizem dia, bangchi mah in hinna laibu a kipat amin ka hihmang kei ding, ka Pa ma leh a-angelte ma ah amin ka gum ding hi.
english: He who overcomes will be arrayed in white garments, and I will in no way blot his name out of the book of life, and I will confess his name before my Father, and before his angels.

paite: "Saptuamte kiang a Kha thugen bil nei peuh in za hen achi, chi in.
english: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies.

paite: "Philadelphia a saptuamte angel kiang ah hichibang in gelh in: Huai siangthoupa, dikpa leh David chabi neipa, amah hon kuamah in akhak theih louh leh amah khak kuamah in ahon theih louhpa'n hiai thilte agen hi.
heading: Philadelphia Saptuamte Kiang A Laikhak
english: “To the angel of the assembly in Philadelphia write: “He who is holy, he who is true, he who has the key of David, he who opens and no one can shut, and who shuts and no one opens, says these things:

paite: "Na thilhihte ka thei, ngai in, na ma ah kuamah khak theih louh kong honsa ka koih hi; thilhihtheihna neuchik na nei a, ka thu na kem a, ka min na pai kei hi.
english: “I know your works (behold, I have set before you an open door, which no one can shut), that you have a little power, and kept my word, and didn’t deny my name.

paite: Ngai in, zuau lel gen a Judate hilou napi, ahi a kigen Setan sinagogte ka hon pia hi; ngai in, amau ka hon paisak dia, na khebul ah ka kunsak ding; nang ka hon itdan atheihna ding un.
english: Behold, I give of the synagogue of Satan, of those who say they are Jews, and they are not, but lie. Behold, I will make them to come and worship before your feet, and to know that I have loved you.

paite: Ka dohzohna thu na kep ziak in, ze-et a na om chiang in ke'n leng ka hon kem ding, huai hun khovel pumpi tung a hong tung ding ahi; leitung a om tengteng leng ze-et ding in.
english: Because you kept my command to endure, I also will keep you from the hour of testing, which is to come on the whole world, to test those who dwell on the earth.

paite: Ka hong pai pah ding. Kuamah in na lallukhu alaklouhna ding in, na neih pen kem kinken in.
english: I am coming quickly! Hold firmly that which you have, so that no one takes your crown.

paite: Avualzoupa ka tempul ah khuam in ka pangsak dia, huai a kipan in apaikhe nawn kei ding, amah tung ah ka Pathian min leh ka Pathian khopi Jerusalem thak, ka Pathian a kipan van a hong paikhesuk min leh keimah min thak ka gelh ding hi.
english: He who overcomes, I will make him a pillar in the temple of my God, and he will go out from there no more. I will write on him the name of my God, and the name of the city of my God, the new Jerusalem, which comes down out of heaven from my God, and my own new name.

paite: "Saptuamte kiang a Kha thugen bil nei peuh in za hen achi," chi in.
english: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies.

paite: "Huan Laodisia a saptuamte angel kiang ah hichibang in gelh in: Theihpihpa ginom leh dik, Pathian thilsiam bul Amen in hiai thilte agen hi.
heading: Laodisia Saptuamte Kiang A Laikhak
english: “To the angel of the assembly in Laodicea write: “The Amen, the Faithful and True Witness, the Head of God’s creation, says these things:

paite: "Na thilhihte ka thei, lum lah lum lou, vot lah vot lou in na om a; na lumleh lum inla na votleh vot vanglak in!
english: “I know your works, that you are neither cold nor hot. I wish you were cold or hot.

paite: Lum lah lum lou, vot lah vot lou a na om pelhpulh ziak in, ka kam a kipan in ka hon sekhe ding hi.
english: So, because you are lukewarm, and neither hot nor cold, I will vomit you out of my mouth.

paite: Migenthei nuamsa lou, zawng, mitdel leh vuaktang na hih lam kithei lou a, 'ka hausa, hauhsaknate ka neita, bangmah ka kitasam kei,' na chih ziak in.
english: Because you say, ‘I am rich, and have gotten riches, and have need of nothing;’ and don’t know that you are the wretched one, miserable, poor, blind, and naked;

paite: Kei a kipan in dangka-eng mei a hihsiangthousa lei ding in ka hon thuhilh ahi, na hong hauhsak theihna ding in; puanngoute na hon silh a, na vuaktang zumhuaina adawklouhna ding in; huan na muhtheihna ding in na mit a nuh ding mitlou lei in.
english: I counsel you to buy from me gold refined by fire, that you may become rich; and white garments, that you may clothe yourself, and that the shame of your nakedness may not be revealed; and eye salve to anoint your eyes, that you may see.

paite: Ka itte ka thuhilh in ka sawi a; huaiziak in phatuamngai inla, kisik in.
english: As many as I love, I reprove and chasten. Be zealous therefore, and repent.

paite: Ngai in kongkhak a dingh in ka kiu hi; mi kuapeuh in ka aw azak a kong ahonleh akiang ah ka lut dia amah toh nitak an ka ne dia, ama'n leng kei toh ane ding hi.
english: Behold, I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, then I will come in to him, and will dine with him, and he with me.

paite: Avualzoupa ka laltutphah tung ah ka kiang ah ka tusak ding, kei leng ka vualzou a, laltutphah tung a ka Pa toh ka tut bang in.
english: He who overcomes, I will give to him to sit down with me on my throne, as I also overcame, and sat down with my Father on his throne.

paite: "Saptuamte kiang a Kha thugen bil nei peuh in za hen achi," chi in achi hi.
english: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies.”
